rules.sentence: A normal V/Q scan accurately excludes chronic thromboembolic disease with a sensitivity of 96% to 97% and a specificity of 90% to 95%.
A V/Q scan suggestive of chronic thromboembolic disease should be confirmed by pulmonary angiography, which can also determine the condition’s extent.
V/Q scans are an important part of the diagnostic evaluation because pulmonary hypertension due to chronic thromboembolic disease is potentially reversible with surgery.
